name: rental-admin
description: File admin panel monorepo: Next.js frontend, Express API, PostgreSQL and private AWS S3 storage.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @rental-admin/shared build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @rental-admin/api dev" "pnpm --filter @rental-admin/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rental-admin/shared build && pnpm --filter @rental-admin/api build && pnpm --filter @rental-admin/web build
